Co trzeba przygotować do rozpoczęcia pro: What do I need to start a design?
Lokalizację, orientacyjne wymiary, zdjęc: Location, approximate dimensions, site photos and details of who will play and which sports. I prepare an initial concept from these. Documentation is not needed at the start.
Czy mogę zaprojektować boisko sam?: Can I design a court myself?
Tak. W Studio 3D wybierasz model, kolor: Yes. In 3D Studio, choose the model, frame colour, surface and pattern, and the price updates live. Download the project PDF and submit it for a quote. Check site dimensions first in the “Will it fit?” planner.
Co zawiera projekt koncepcyjny?: What does a concept design include?
Układ boiska na placu ze strefami i dojś: Court layout with zones and access, 3D view, pattern and markings, surface and substrate selection, and price. For municipalities and schools, technical specifications and funding and tender documents are also included.
Ile kosztuje boisko z projektu?: How much does a designed court cost?
Konstrukcje Gamefields kosztują od 36 00: Gamefields structures start at PLN 36,000 excluding VAT, concrete slab with sub-base at PLN 283/m², and surfaces from PLN 78/m². 3D Studio displays the design price; installation, transport and site preparation are quoted after reviewing photos.
Czy projekt może uwzględniać branding?: Can branding be included in the design?
Tak. Barwy i znak miasta, szkoły, klubu: Yes. City, school, club or partner colours and logos can be integrated into the surface, boards and staging without compromising clarity of play.
Czy pomagacie przy projekcie do wniosku: Can you help with a design for a funding application?
Tak. Przygotowuję koncepcję, parametry t: Yes. I prepare the concept, specifications and funding and tender documentation, including manufacturers' data sheets and certificates. Polish 2027 funding rounds open from 4 January.
Czy później możecie wykonać zaprojektowa: Can you build the designed court afterwards?
Tak. Projekt może być samodzielnym etape: Yes. Design can be a standalone stage or the start of construction, renovation or painting. That was the process in Kraków, from site plan to completed park arena.
Czym projekt koncepcyjny różni się od wi: How does a concept design differ from a visualisation?
Wizualizacja pokazuje wygląd. Koncepcja: A visualisation shows appearance. A Gamefields concept also includes dimensions, zones, surface, substrate and price: a solution that can be built. I always label visualisations and completed projects separately on the website.
